_about: General structure of a synthgen contract. Values are placeholders: 'string', 'integer', 'number', 'boolean', 'date (YYYY-MM-DD)', or 'a | b | c' for an enumeration. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only. 'ref' means a column reference (see _references). Any value anywhere may be replaced by {"$ref": "#/path/to/value"} pointing elsewhere in the same contract.

_references.entity.column: value of a column in the current step (own entity, an ancestor, or a child entity inside an aggregate)
_references.entity.column@t-1: value of a column in the previous step (stepped entities only; the column must declare 'init')
_references.step.<name>: statement_date | cycle_start_date | days_in_cycle | cycle_number | months_on_book | step_index | month_of_year
_references.shared.<name>: value of a shared series at the current step
_references.row.<name>: ordinal | seq (seq exists on event entities only)

_column_types: string | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | integer | decimal(precision,scale) | float | boolean | date | timestamp

volume.steps: integer - number of output time steps (used by time.output_steps via $ref)

pins.<rule name>: string - version to use (otherwise the latest version is used)

rounding.mode: half_up | half_even | floor | ceil | down (default half_up)

parameters.<any name>: any JSON value - reusable values referenced with {"$ref": "#/parameters/<name>"}

time._required_when: the contract has a stepped entity
time.output_start: date (YYYY-MM-DD) - cycle_number 1 is the statement in this month
time.warmup_max_steps: integer | null - steps simulated before the window and discarded (null = from each entity's start date)

anchor.start_date: ref - date column of the stepped entity's parent (e.g. account.open_date)
anchor.cycle_day: ref - int column with bounds.max <= 28 (monthly_cycle_day calendar only)

<stepped entity name>._note: use 'anchors' instead of 'anchor' when there are several stepped entities

<entity name>.parent: string - entity name (stepped: a static entity; event: a stepped entity)
<entity name>.count: static: integer (alternative to volume.<entity>) | event: ref to an integer column of the parent (required for event)
<entity name>.max_per_parent: integer - event only: upper bound of the count column (default 500)
<entity name>.terminal_when: ref - stepped only: boolean column of this entity; true stops the entity after that step
order_by: string - event only: columns that order rows within a parent step (e.g. a timestamp)
<entity name>.emit: boolean - write this entity to CSV (default true)

members: string - joint column names of this entity
correlation: number - symmetric, unit diagonal, positive definite; one row per member

node._about: One column. Every node has exactly one 'kind'. See node_fields_by_kind for which fields apply.
node.kind: identifier | parent_key | reference | lookup | context | drawn | decorative | joint | derived | state | aggregate (required)
node.emit: boolean - write to CSV (default true; false = internal helper column)
node.null_rate: number in [0,1) - drawn/decorative only; needs nullable: true

format.pattern: string - identifier pattern, e.g. ACC-[A-Z0-9]{10} (literals, [..] sets/ranges, \d, {n})

values: string | number | boolean - category labels; also the label set for derived string columns
weights: number - sums to 1 (used when this is a categorical draw without dist/params)

bounds.on_violation: truncate | reject | clip | error | warn (drawn default truncate = draw inside the bounds; derived default error = checked by verify)

quantization.round_to: number in value units (e.g. 500, 0.0025, 0.05); must be a multiple of 10^-scale
quantization.mode: half_up | half_even | floor | ceil | down (default conventions.rounding.mode)

node.init: number | boolean | date | null - value read at @t-1 on an entity's first step (required for state nodes and anything read with @t-1)
node.references: ref - identifier column (parent_key: an ancestor's id; reference: a static entity's id)
node.weights: ref - reference only: numeric column of the target entity used as selection weight
node.via: ref - lookup only: a reference column of this entity
node.from: ref - lookup only: column of the referenced entity to copy
node.source: ref - context only: step.<name> or row.<name>
node.dist: categorical | bernoulli | normal | lognormal | uniform | uniform_int | poisson | beta | exponential | date_uniform | constant
node.conditioned_on: ref - categorical column; params then become one block per category label (or 'default')

params._per_row_value: a param value may also be {"by": ref, "values": {label: value}, "default": value} or {"input": ref}
params._rule_params: for rule-based nodes: { <rule param name>: literal | per-row value }

terms.transform: identity | gt0 | log | log1p | sqrt | square (applied first)
terms.null_as: number - contribution when the input is NULL (default 0)

node.zero_mass: number | per-row value - probability that a drawn value is exactly 0
node.allocation: random | exact - exact = quota allocation (static, unconditioned categorical only)
node.group: string - joint only: name of a joint_groups entry of this entity
node.rule: string - rule name (derived/state: a rule; drawn/decorative: a sampler)
node.version: string - pin this node to a rule version

inputs.<rule argument name>: ref - must match the rule signature exactly

node.over: string - aggregate only: child event entity name
node.fn: sum | count | mean | min | max (aggregate only; default sum)
node.of: string - aggregate only: child column (not needed for count)
node.where: string - aggregate only: expression over child columns, e.g. "transaction_type in ['purchase'] and not is_declined"

optional: same as drawn - a drawn column with no relationships

inputs.<argument>: float | int | bool | date | timestamp | category | any

<custom.rule_name>.output: float | int | bool | date | timestamp | category | any
<custom.rule_name>.override: boolean - replace a library rule with the same name and version

invariants.name: string
invariants.expression: string - must be true on every row

targets.where: string - share only: expression whose true-share is measured
targets.of: string - mean only: expression whose mean is measured

calibrate.parameter: string - JSON pointer into a node, e.g. /entities/<e>/nodes/<col>/linear_predictor/intercept_shift
calibrate.direction: increasing | decreasing - how the metric moves when the parameter increases
